mainEntity.name: What is Masterstroke Academy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Masterstroke Academy is India's structured blockchain developer program built on MST Chain, an EVM-compatible hybrid Layer-1 blockchain. It covers Solidity, DeFi, NFTs, DAOs, ZK Proofs, and smart contract security across 4 phases and 21 modules, with live code execution on a real blockchain.

mainEntity.name: Is the Masterstroke Academy blockchain course free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, enrollment is free to start. Fellowship plans unlock full curriculum access, leaderboard reward tokens, and internship eligibility.

mainEntity.name: Do I need prior coding or blockchain experience to join?

acceptedAnswer.text: No prior blockchain experience is required. The course begins with internet fundamentals and cryptography basics before progressing to Solidity smart contract development.

mainEntity.name: How many modules and hours does the course include?

acceptedAnswer.text: 21 modules across 4 phases, with 123 submodules and 130+ hours of total content.

mainEntity.name: What is the structure of the 4 phases?

acceptedAnswer.text: Phase 1 covers internet, decentralisation, and blockchain foundations (4 modules, ~18 hours). Phase 2 covers the MST difference and developer tooling (4 modules, ~20 hours). Phase 3 is the core project phase building your startup MVP (9 modules, ~70 hours). Phase 4 covers the path from developer to funded founder or intern, including grants, pitching, and career (4 modules, ~22 hours).

mainEntity.name: What is the assessment pass rate?

acceptedAnswer.text: You must score at least 70% on each submodule assessment to unlock the next lesson. Assessments include MCQ and true/false (35%), coding and completion exercises (30%), descriptive and design questions (15%), projects and practicals (12%), and presentations and pitches (8%).

mainEntity.name: What certificate do I receive on completing the course?

acceptedAnswer.text: A verifiable on-chain certificate recorded on MST Blockchain - one of the first blockchain-native developer credentials in India, publicly verifiable without contacting the academy.

mainEntity.name: Can I get funding after completing the course?

acceptedAnswer.text: Top capstone projects presented at Demo Day are eligible for MST ecosystem grants of up to $50,000 USD to launch their startup MVP.

mainEntity.name: What blockchain is used for live coding and deployment?

acceptedAnswer.text: MST Chain, an EVM-compatible hybrid Layer-1 blockchain built for India. All coding exercises, testnet deployments, and the on-chain certificate run on MST Chain.

mainEntity.name: What topics are covered in Solidity and smart contract development?

acceptedAnswer.text: Data types, functions, modifiers, events, inheritance, interfaces, the ABI, gas optimisation, upgradeable proxy patterns, ERC-20/ERC-721/ERC-1155 token standards, and formal security auditing techniques including reentrancy and access-control vulnerability analysis.

mainEntity.name: Does the course cover DeFi development?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. DeFi development is covered in Phase 3, including AMM DEX architecture, lending and borrowing protocols, yield mechanisms, and tokenomics design, all deployed on MST Chain.

mainEntity.name: Does the course cover NFTs and DAOs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. NFT development covers ERC-721 and ERC-1155 standards, marketplace mechanics, and royalties. DAO development covers governance contracts, on-chain voting, and treasury management.

mainEntity.name: What is ZK Proofs and does the course cover it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zero-knowledge proofs allow verifying information without revealing the underlying data. The course covers ZK Proof fundamentals and privacy-preserving application design as part of Phase 3.

mainEntity.name: Is the course integrated with college curricula in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Masterstroke Academy's syllabus is structured to align with academic and industry standards, enabling college integration for engineering and computer science programs across India.

mainEntity.name: What is the Fellowship plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Fellowship plan is a paid enrollment tier offering lifetime access to the full curriculum, internship eligibility, and leaderboard-based rewards, beyond what the free tier includes.

mainEntity.name: How does the leaderboard and streak system work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your rank updates automatically based on progress in the Learning Tree. Top performers on the leaderboard qualify for Fellowship bonuses and internship consideration.

mainEntity.name: Who operates Masterstroke Academy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Masterstroke Academy is operated by Masterstroke Technosoft Private Limited.

mainEntity.name: Is there a refund policy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Masterstroke Academy has a published refund policy available at masterstroke.academy/refund-policy.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete the full curriculum?

acceptedAnswer.text: The curriculum totals 130+ hours across 21 modules. Pace is self-directed, with most learners completing it in 4 to 6 months studying part-time.

mainEntity.name: What makes Masterstroke Academy different from other blockchain courses in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Three main differences: live code execution on MST Chain, a real EVM-compatible blockchain rather than a simulator; an on-chain verifiable certificate; and a funding path through MST ecosystem grants of up to $50,000 for top capstone projects.
